# md v0.12.0 - Table of Contents

Custom extendable markdown parser.

## Pages

- [Md](https://md.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Custom Markdown Pipelines](https://md.hexdocs.pm/md-benefits.md)
- [Handler Parameters Reference](https://md.hexdocs.pm/handler-parameters.md)

## Modules

- [Md](https://md.hexdocs.pm/Md.md): `Md` is a markup parser allowing fully customized syntax definition and
understanding the wide range of [markdown](https://www.markdownguide.org/) out of the box.
- [Md.Guards](https://md.hexdocs.pm/Md.Guards.md): Several guards for the proper UTF8 handling of input.
- [Md.Listener](https://md.hexdocs.pm/Md.Listener.md): The listener behaviour to attach to the parser to receive callbacks
when the elements are encountered and processed.

- [Md.Parser](https://md.hexdocs.pm/Md.Parser.md): Interface to implement for the custopm parsers.
- [Md.Transforms](https://md.hexdocs.pm/Md.Transforms.md): Custom transforms behaviour to be implemented by custom handlers

- Parser Internals
  - [Md.Parser.Default](https://md.hexdocs.pm/Md.Parser.Default.md): Default parser with all the features included.
  - [Md.Parser.State](https://md.hexdocs.pm/Md.Parser.State.md): The internal state of the parser.

  - [Md.Parser.Syntax](https://md.hexdocs.pm/Md.Parser.Syntax.md): The behaviour for the custom syntax suppliers

  - [Md.Parser.Syntax.Void](https://md.hexdocs.pm/Md.Parser.Syntax.Void.md): Void syntax to be extended by custom implementations. Included for convenience.

- Custom Transforms
  - [Md.Transforms.Anchor](https://md.hexdocs.pm/Md.Transforms.Anchor.md): Anchor transformation to image or twitter card
  - [Md.Transforms.Footnote](https://md.hexdocs.pm/Md.Transforms.Footnote.md): Internal transformation to format footnotes
  - [Md.Transforms.Soundcloud](https://md.hexdocs.pm/Md.Transforms.Soundcloud.md): Internal transformation to embed soundcloud audios
  - [Md.Transforms.TwitterHandle](https://md.hexdocs.pm/Md.Transforms.TwitterHandle.md): Internal transformation to format twitter handles
  - [Md.Transforms.Youtube](https://md.hexdocs.pm/Md.Transforms.Youtube.md): Internal transformation to embed youtube videos
